headword: {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}

definitions.explanation: A dangerous medical condition in which the body's core temperature drops below the normal range, typically below 35°C. Can occur from prolonged exposure to cold, wet conditions, or immersion in cold water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遭難者|そうなんしゃ}→遭難者：27894_sounansha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れていた→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧。
examples.english: The stranded person had collapsed from hypothermia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{短時間|たんじかん}→短時間：18286_tanjikan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you fall into the winter sea, there is a risk of developing hypothermia in a short time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Elderly people can develop hypothermia even indoors, so managing the heating is important.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{低|てい}→低〜：03961_tei⟧ (low), ⟦{体温|たいおん}→体温：03385_taion⟧ (body temperature), and {症|しょう} (condition, disease). A medical term that appears frequently in news reports about outdoor accidents, natural disasters, and winter safety.

In Japan, {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう} is commonly discussed in the context of mountain climbing accidents, where sudden weather changes can catch hikers unprepared. It is also a concern for elderly people living alone, particularly during winter months when indoor heating may be insufficient.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop hypothermia
- {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to suffer from hypothermia
- {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to die of hypothermia
- {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent hypothermia
- {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: symptoms of hypothermia

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{凍傷|とうしょう}→凍傷：05018_toushou⟧: frostbite — localized damage to skin and tissue from freezing, distinct from the systemic cooling of {低体温症|ていたいおんしょう}
- ⟦{低体温|ていたいおん}→低体温：26320_teitaion⟧: low body temperature — describes the condition of having a low temperature without necessarily implying a dangerous medical state
- ⟦{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}→熱中症：08330_necchuushou⟧: heatstroke — the opposite condition, caused by overheating
